owner_request:
Implement Flutter biometric auth service and MFA verification UI screen:
1. mobile/lib/features/auth/services/biometric_service.dart:
   - Class BiometricService: checks if local biometrics (FaceID/Fingerprint) are supported/enrolled, authenticates with localizedReason string, handles fallback.
2. mobile/lib/features/auth/screens/mfa_verify_screen.dart:
   - StatefulWidget MfaVerifyScreen with 6-digit PIN input fields (or pin controller).
   - Auto-submit when 6 digits are entered.
   - Countdown timer for 30s TOTP refresh window.
   - 'Verify' button with loading indicator.
   - Biometric prompt button (if enabled).
   - Friendly error handling on invalid code.
